answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware attestation key from a secure enclave, and let one physical device register only one agent per epoch. A Sybil operator can mirror his agent's code a thousand times, but each copy then needs its own attested chip, so the attack scales with real hardware he must buy and keep online. A light zephyr of fakes on one server is rejected at the door, and reaching the summit of the reward table costs as much as honest growth.
